answer: The defence rests on scrabble club membership with tournament word record: tournaments played under one club across seasons. Forging 311 of these means building 311 separate tournament records from scratch, and years of history cannot be bought in bulk. The karst test is the price tag: 311 fakes mean 311 payments. Verification runs against the issuer's own registry every epoch, so a forged entry is caught on the next check. The nadir signal is visible to every grader, and the garden ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
